name: parlayapi-mcp
description: Sports odds tools for personal and internal research, with keyless public previews and account-based odds and analytics.
long_description:
MCP server for [ParlayAPI](https://parlay-api.com), with sports odds and analytics tools for personal and internal research. Coverage and availability vary; use the source-quality and book-coverage tools to inspect the current service.

Public discovery, pricing, preview and coverage tools work without an API key. Authenticated odds and analytics tools use your own ParlayAPI account. Current plans are at https://parlay-api.com/pricing.

The server also exposes tools to create an account, send a login email, generate a checkout link and save book preferences. Invoke these account or preference actions only when requested by the user.

tools.name: parlayapi_signup
tools.description: Create a free-tier ParlayAPI account and get a working API key (keyless)

tools.name: parlayapi_checkout_link

tools.name: parlayapi_live_sports

tools.name: parlayapi_live_search

tools.name: parlayapi_get_props

parlayapi_key.title: ParlayAPI Key
parlayapi_key.description: Optional. Leave blank to start keyless: signup, pricing, live previews, source quality, and coverage tools work with no key, and the signup tool can create one for you. Odds and analytics tools need a key. Free tier: 1,000 credits per month, no card, at https://parlay-api.com.
